note: Held tier-4 maker datasheet for the Boxer Armoured Personnel Carrier. It publishes the maximum gross vehicle weight, the engine type and capacity, the maximum road speed, the range, the turning radius and the overall length, width, height and ground clearance. It publishes no kerb or operating weight, no tyre size, no transmission class and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.

entries.maker: ARTEC GmbH (KNDS Deutschland and Rheinmetall Landsysteme)

gross_weight_kg.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Max. gross vehicle weight row
gross_weight_kg.state: maximum gross vehicle weight published as up to 38.5 t; recorded as 38,500 kg with the tonne taken as 1,000 kg; the datasheet publishes no kerb or operating weight

length_mm.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Length row

width_mm.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Width row

height_mm.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Height (hull roof) row
height_mm.state: height to the hull roof published as 2.38 m; the datasheet publishes no height over a mission module

ground_clearance_mm.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Ground clearance row

engine_model.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Engine type row
engine_model.state: engine type published as MTU V8 199TE20/21

published_power_hp.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Engine capacity (ISO) row
published_power_hp.state: engine capacity published as up to 600 kW (816 hp) with an ISO basis; the published horsepower figure is recorded

wheel_count.state: the datasheet describes the Boxer as an armoured 8x8 combat vehicle

turning_radius_m.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Turning radius row
turning_radius_m.state: turning radius published as 7.50 m (skid steering)

max_speed_kmh.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Maximum speed row
max_speed_kmh.state: maximum speed published as greater than 100 km/h; the stated bound of 100 km/h is recorded, not an average

range_km.locator: Product data panel, Key figures, Range row
range_km.state: range published as greater than 1,000 km; the stated bound of 1,000 km is recorded, not an average
